title: ci: unify lint/test pipelines, add dependency caching and pin GH Actions
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: CI run times and flaky lint/test failures have been a major drag on developer velocity and CI costs. This PR consolidates duplicated pipeline steps across multiple GitHub Actions workflows into a single reusable workflow, introduces dependency caching across language ecosystems (npm, pip, Go modules), pins key GH Actions to fixed versions to reduce transient failures, and refactors a few helper scripts for deterministic behavior. Scope: - Consolidate .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml into .github/workflows/ci.yml using reusable workflows and matrix jobs. - Add caching layers: npm cache, pip cache (pip cache dir + wheelhouse), and Go module cache. - Pin community actions (actions/checkout@v4 -> actions/checkout@v4; setup-node@v4 pinned to v4.4.0; setup-python pinned to 4.5.0) and internal actions to semver tags. - Add a lightweight scripts/ci/install_deps.sh to provide hermetic install steps used by both main repo and submodules. - Update Makefile targets so local dev mirrors CI: make lint, make test, make ci-fast. - Small cleanup: remove legacy workflows, update README CI section, and bump dev-deps for linters to latest compatible versions. Checklist: - [x] Reusable workflow created and validated locally with act and in staging branch CI. - [x] Caches added for npm/pip/go and validated to improve cold-start times. - [x] Pin actions and document rationale in CONTRIBUTING.md. - [x] Update Makefile and dev docs. - [x] Run full test matrix on a fork and fix failing flakes. Related Linear/Jira: ENG-4217 (CI unification), ENG-4301 (cache strategy). Backwards compatibility and risks: No API changes. CI-only; no runtime code changes to production components except deterministic install order. Risk: cache key collisions causing stale deps; mitigated by including lockfile checksums in cache keys. Notes on verification: See CI checks below and commit messages for details.

review_comments: Mateo Rivera: Nice consolidation, can we keep separate workflows for the large integration matrix to avoid long-running jobs blocking fast PRs?
Ava Chen: I kept the integration matrix but moved it to a workflow_dispatch and schedule so it doesn't run on every PR; see ci.yml lines 60-85.
Priya Patel: Please ensure cache keys include lockfile checksum. Observed stale node_modules in previous experiment.
Ava Chen: Added lockfile checksums for npm and pip caches and included a 'cache-reset' input for workflows to force eviction.
Luca Moretti: Lint step is failing intermittently on windows runners due to path case-sensitivity. Can we normalize paths in the linter wrapper?
Ava Chen: Normalized paths in scripts/ci/install_deps.sh and updated eslint config to use posix-like resolver; added unit test for path normalization.
Mateo Rivera: CI run time dropped ~45% on cold start with caches; approving after rerun of full matrix.
Priya Patel: Verified pins to actions are documented in CONTRIBUTING.md and security rationale included. Approved.
release_notes: Chore: Unify CI pipelines and add dependency caching. Improves CI stability and reduces run times. No production behavior changes.
notes: Observed roughly 30-60% faster median CI runtime for PRs with cache hits. Cold starts are ~45% faster. We intentionally pinned a small set of actions to reduce flakes; we will revisit quarterly to bump pinned versions after validation. This PR also paves the way for centralizing repo-level reusable workflows across SDK repos.
manual_steps_after_merge: None. Workflows are active after merge. Maintainers may run .github/workflows/ci.yml workflow_dispatch to warm caches for release branches.
security_impact: Low. Only pins existing third-party GH Actions and documents rationale. No credential changes. Cache keys avoid sensitive data and use lockfile checksums.
